=== Caldera Pyremaw  (backend/cardfns/CalderaPyremaw.go) ===
Caldera Pyremaw — {3}{R}{R} Creature (TDC)

	Flying
	Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, put a +1/+1 counter on
	  this creature. Then this creature deals damage equal to its power to
	  target opponent.

CardHandler: subscribes to EventSpellCast, filtering for instant/sorcery
spells cast by the controller. On trigger, adds a +1/+1 counter, then
deals damage to an opponent equal to the creature's current power.
Auto-selects the first opponent (engine convention for "target opponent"
in triggers, see AcidicSlime.go / GainControlOfFirstOpponent.go).


=== ExaltedFlamerOfTzeentch  (backend/cardfns/ExaltedFlamerOfTzeentch.go) ===
ExaltedFlamerOfTzeentch implements Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch (40K):
{2}{U}{R} Creature.

	Sorcerous Inspiration — At the beginning of your upkeep, return an
	  instant or sorcery card at random from your graveyard to your hand.
	Fire of Tzeentch — Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this
	  creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.

CardHandler: the upkeep trigger collects the controller's instant/sorcery
cards in the graveyard and returns a random one (math/rand, same idiom as
GontiLordOfLuxury/HoardingOgre); the cast trigger mirrors the
AshlingFlameDancer EventSpellCast filter and fires DamageEachOpponent.


=== Mercurial Spelldancer  (backend/cardfns/MercurialSpelldancer.go) ===
Mercurial Spelldancer — {1}{U} Creature (ONE)

	This creature can't be blocked.
	Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put an oil counter on this creature.
	Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may remove two
	oil counters from it. If you do, when you next cast an instant or sorcery
	spell this turn, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.

CardHandler: grants unblockable via GrantCantBeBlocked. Subscribes to
EventSpellCast to add an oil counter if the spell is noncreature (instant,
sorcery, or enchantment). Subscribes to EventDealsPlayerDamage to remove
oil counters and arm a one-shot spell-copy effect. The one-shot copies the
next instant or sorcery cast this turn via CopySpellOnStack.
